thread:
Ava (support): FYI incoming escalation from Acme Corp — invoice INV-2026-114 is on hold. Customer says they expect Net 30 per contract but finance is blocking for missing PO and VAT mismatch. card payment attempt also failed earlier. Can someone triage?

Priya (acct): Thanks, heading in. Do we have the customer's preferred payment term in SF? I remember a one-off net30 approval last quarter but not sure. @Diego can you confirm policy? :eyes:

Diego (finance): Policy: standard is Net 60 for new enterprise customers unless sales secures Net 30 in writing. If VAT ID doesn't validate, we can't apply reverse charge. Need PO + VAT docs to proceed with arrears. We saw a card decline for $18,240 at 09:14 UTC — billing-bot logged failed auth.

billing-bot: Payment attempt failed: txn_6f8a2c — card_declined (insufficient_funds). Attempted at 2026-07-14T09:14:22Z. Invoice INV-2026-114 remains unpaid.

Liam (cs): Customer claims their AP already sent PO via email to billing@redwood.ai yesterday. Attached screenshot they pasted in the support ticket. I pulled the email thread but the PO number in their email (PO-8893) doesn't match the PO field on the invoice (empty). Looks like our ingestion failed to map attachments for that domain.

Ava (support): Copying the email headers below and attaching ticket: 
From: ap@acmecorp.com
Subject: PO-8893 for Redwood services
Attachments: PO-8893.pdf (13KB)

Priya (acct): If the PO exists we can update the invoice metadata and re-run billing. @Diego — can we provision a temporary 7-day provisional credit or payment hold while we verify the VAT ID and ingest the PO? Customer is asking for Net 30 not Net 60.

Diego (finance): We can do provisional hold for 7 days for review, but Net 30 override requires completed credit review + signed amendment. For now I can mark the invoice as "hold - pending PO/VAT" so it doesn't auto-escalate to collections. Please confirm we received a legally valid VAT ID.

Marta (legal): Share the VAT number and country. If they're an EU business and VAT ID validates via VIES, we can zero-rate VAT. If not, tax still applies and finance will require prepay or card capture. I can fast-track validation if Priya drops the VAT docs here or in a secure ticket.

Liam (cs): Customer provided VAT: EU123456789 — I ran a quick check, VIES returns mismatched name. Screenshot attached. They insist the ID is correct and that their AP sometimes uses a group VAT (different registered name).

Priya (acct): Ok — next steps I propose: 1) Priya to request customer to resend PO with matching legal name and reattach VAT registration PDF, 2) Ava to update support ticket with the PO ingestion failure and ask for a secure upload link, 3) Diego to mark invoice on hold for 7 days, 4) Marta to validate VAT once docs arrive.

Ava (support): Actioned — asked customer to upload PO and VAT PDF to secure portal (link sent). Also asked them whether they'd prefer Net 30 with a signed amendment or to prepay via card now to avoid service interruption.

Customer (quoted by Liam): "We can sign the amendment and switch to Net 30 but need the invoice metadata updated to include our PO-8893 so our AP can auto-pay. We'll resend VAT docs today."

Diego (finance): I'll set the invoice flag to HOLD and disable auto-collections. If we get PO + validated VAT within 7 days, we'll release and allow Net 30 after amendment execution. Otherwise default Net 60/collection policy applies.

Marta (legal): I'll stand by to expedite amendment template once Priya confirms the customer's legal entity name. If the VAT validation still fails we need a short legal confirmation that the customer acknowledges tax liability to avoid future disputes.

Ava (support): Noted. FYI billing-bot recorded two more auth attempts that failed this morning at 07:02 and 08:59 — looks like AP retried with a different card last night. Customer told us they pulled a new card today.

billing-bot: Payment attempts summary for INV-2026-114: 
- 2026-07-14T07:02:11Z txn_6f7a11 — card_declined (expired_card)
- 2026-07-14T08:59:03Z txn_6f88f2 — card_declined (insufficient_funds)
- 2026-07-14T09:14:22Z txn_6f8a2c — card_declined (insufficient_funds)

Priya (acct): I'll ask sales to confirm whether we have previous signed Net 30 approvals for this account and draft amendment if needed. @Liam can you ping the customer for the secure upload and confirm expected ETA? :spiral_calendar:

Liam (cs): Pinged — customer says they'll upload PO + VAT by EOD today. I also asked them to try a different payment method if they want to clear outstanding balance immediately.

Diego (finance): Thanks. I'll hold off on collections and put a 7-day flag. If docs come in, I'll validate and send reconciliation instructions to AP. If they prepay now we'll mark invoice as paid and drop the amendment requirement for this invoice only.

Ava (support): Great. Marking thread resolved for now — reopening if PO/VAT not received by 2026-07-21. Assigned actions: Priya (gather contract/amendment), Liam (confirm upload), Diego (place hold), Marta (standby for VAT/legal). :white_check_mark:
